verdict.rationale: USCIS runs online accounts and APIs that hold user data, so where that data is stored is a fair privacy question. However, nothing in the evidence describes any user-selectable storage region or data-residency option. The pack covers only online filing, case status, FOIA APIs, the sandbox, and G-28 delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
